51)chos nyid mkha' 'gro'i gsang mdzod las:yang gsang bla med sngags kyi lam mchog phyag rgya gnyis ldan mkha' 'gro'i thugs bcud sbas pa mngon bstan zab lam snyi

tei:div.tei:p: 51) chos nyid mkha' 'gro'i gsang mdzod las: yang gsang bla med sngags kyi lam mchog phyag rgya gnyis ldan mkha' 'gro'i thugs bcud sbas pa mngon bstan zab lam snying po zhes bya ba bzhugs pa'i dbu'o: 52)stong dbyings shes rab rdo rje rnal 'byor ma: rang byung lhan skyes rnal 'byor wā ra hi: sna tshogs yum gyur mkha' 'gro mthing 'od 'bar: sku gsum mkha' 'gro'i tshogs la gus pas 'dud: rig 'dzin gsang ba'i lam mchog khyad 'phags chos: shin tu gsang ba las kyang ches gsang ba: yang gsang bla med myur lam rnying po'i chos: dag dang ma dag sgyu lus la brten nas: zung 'jug rdo rje 'chang dbang sgrub pa'i thabs: skal ldan sems kyi bu yi don du bstan: sa ma ya: de la dang po gsang sngags bla med kyi dbang bzhi pas rgyud smin grol gyi lam la 53)'jug: thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa'i bskyed rdzogs zung 'jug bsgoms pas 'bras bu tshe gcig rdo rje 'chang gi go 'phang thob par byed pa la dang po rang lus thabs dang ldan dgos: rang lus thabs dang ma ldan na gzhan lus phyag rgyar brten pas grol mi srid: sa ma ya: dang po rang lus thabs ldan ni: stong ra gsum dang rlung la slob: rtsa dang rlung dang thig le dag: rdo rje gsum gyi sku ru smin: ces gsungs te: de la dang po phyi sgyur la lus kyi stong ra ni: rang nyid rdo rje rnal 'byor ma dmar mor gsal ba'i sku dbus su: 54)rtsa dbu ma dang: g.yas su ro ma: g.yon du rkyang ma: de gsum sku gsum gyi mtshon byed du mthing dkar dmar ba'i kha dog 'bar zhing khrag dang chu ser gyis ma gos pa'i rtsa gsum sba phran gshib pa ltar yar sne spyi bo dang mar sne gsang gnas su zug pa: gnas lngar ye shes lnga'i rang mdangs las byung ba'i spyi bor rtsa 'dab sngo skya so gnyis kha thur bstan: mgrin par rtsa 'dab dmar skya bcu drug kha gyen bstan: snying gar rtsa 'dab dkar ser brgyad kha thur bstan:

lte bar rtsa 'dab ser skya so gnyis kha gyen bstan: gsang gnas rtsa 'dab drug cu rtsa bzhi kha gyen bstan: rtsa de dag 'od rtsa ye shes kyi rlung rgyu ba: de rnams kyi dbus su spyi bor oṃ māṃ dkar po: mgrin par hrīḥpāṃ dmar po: snying gar hūm̐ mūm̐ mthing ga: lte bar trām̐ lām̐ ser po: gsang gnas su āḥtām̐ ljang gu rnams dang: dbus rtsa gsum gyi nang du oṃ dkar āḥdamar hūm̐ mthing ga rnams rdo rje gsum gyi ngo bo dang rigs lnga yab yum gyi sa bon du gsal gdab: rtsa 'dab gzhan rnams su a li dang ka li dkar dmar mthing gsum gyi rnam par 'bru re re bsgom par bya'o: 55) spyi bo bde chen gyi 'khor lo'i 'og tu zla ba nya gang ba haṃḥyig gis mtshan pa: lte bar nyi ma nya gang ba aḥshad kyis mtshan pa can du bsgom: dbu rkyang ro gsum gyi yar sne sna gnyis dang kha la zug pa: mar sne gsang gnas dang chu lam bshang sgo rnams su zug pa: lus drang por 'dug ste rkang pa rdo rje'i dkyil krung bcas bum can kha sbyar du bzung: de yang steng rlung mnan: 'og rlung rngubs: bar rlung gang 'khor lo lnga dang ro rkyang dbu gsum sogs kyi yi ge rnams gsal gdab: sa bon de dag las rang mdog gi 'od zer dpag med 'phros: phyogs bcu'i zhing rab 'byams kyi rgyal dang rgyal sras byang chub sems dpa' rnams dang: bla ma rig 'dzin rgya mtsho'i tshogs dang bcas pa thams cad la mchod pa 'bul: de rnams kyi thugs rje byin rlabs nus mthu ye shes yon tan thams cad 'od zer gyi tshul du bsdus nas rtsa 'khor dang yig 'bru rnams la thim: yang 'od zer phyi nang snod bcud 56)la phog: phyi 'byung ba'i bcud dang dwangs ma: dbyings rang bzhin gyi rnam par dag pa'i ye shes yon tan thams cad dang: nang bcud kyi skye 'gro'i sgrib gsum bag chags dang bcas pa sbyangs: de dag rnams kyi tshe dang bsod nams dpal dang 'byor pa yon tan thams cad bsdus nas rtsa 'khor dang thig le rnams la thim pas rang nyid kyi gzi brjid dang ye shes yon tan thams cad cher 'bar bar bsam mo:

de ltar steng ra gsum la goms nas gsal snang dang ldan pa ni gal shin tu che'o: sa ma ya: de nas 'byung chen gyi rlung 'byung chung gi rlung la bsdu: rags pa'i rlung phra ba'i rlung la bsdu: rtsol ba'i rlung srog gi rlung la bsdu'o: yid bde stong dga' bzhi'i ting nge 'dzin la 'jug pa ni: zur bkod sgyu 'phrul rdor sems ltar ro: de ltar ma dag pa'i sgyu lus sbyangs nas dag pa rgyal ba'i sku gsung thugs rdo rje'i rang bzhin kha sbyor yan lag bdun ldan thob nas kun bzang rdo rje 'chang gi go 'phang thob pa'i myur lam zab mo yin no: sa ma ya: de ltar rang lus thabs dang ldan pa ni rdzogs rim gyi nyams len mthar thug pa yin kyang shin tu myur lam las kyang ches 57)myur ba gzhan lus phyag rgya la brten pa ni gsang ba'i man ngag zab rgya can yin: gzhan lus kyi rtsa ba rig ma mtshan nyid dang ldan pa gal che: phyag rgya de yang rab 'bring tha ma gsum las: snga ma gnyis bsten bya dngos dang: phyi ma bsten du rung tsam yin yang rnal 'byor pa rab 'bring tha ma gsum gyis rang rang gi dbang skal gang yin pa der 'phrad par 'gyur ba yin: grong pa'i chos kyis ma gos pa'i mi mo mtshan rtags dang ldan pa shin tu gal che: de yang smin grol gyi lam la bkod pa ni kha sbyor gyi lam la brten pas zung 'jug gi sku thob pa'i gdams pa zab mo'o: sa ma ya: sbas pa mngon bstan gdams pa ni: rnal 'byor gsang sngags spyod pa'i grogs: mu dra mtshan ldan brtag thabs ni: rang bzhin 'og min zhing dang gnas kyi zhing: don gyi zhing dang lnga ldan bkod pa'i zhing: rang bzhin sprul pa'i zhing dang yul so gnyis: nyi shu rtsa bzhi dur khrod brgyad la sogs: sbas don zhing dang rang byung gnas rnams su: 'bum phrag mkha' 'gro'i sgyu 'phrul bsam mi khyab: ngo bo sku gsum rnam pa sna tshogs 58)ston: 'khor 'das yongs khyab 'gyur med nam mkha'i ngang:

rang bzhin ma 'gags thugs rje'i cho 'phrul las: rigs lnga'i rigs can mi mo'i rnam par 'phrul: pad can dung can ri dwags mig can dang: glang po can dang dpal be'u can dang lnga: de la rab lnga 'bring lnga tha ma lnga: rab lnga yon tan kun tshang reg grol mchog: yid bzhin nor bu las lhag shin tu dkon: 'bring lngas nyams rtogs spel zhing longs spyod 'byor: tha ma rnams la 'brel du mi rung zhing: tshogs 'khor gral bzhag smin grol gdams pa bstsal: de dag gnas skyes zhing las skyes pa dang: grong skyes bskyed rdzogs la gnas sngags las skyes: ma nges tshul du rnal 'byor nyams rtogs spar: sa ma ya: de la gnas skyes ni rgya gar rdo rje gdan dang: o rgyan gyi yul: gangs ti se: lho brag gnas gsum: bsam yas gnas gsum: ra sa 'phrul snang: tsā riḥpadma bkod sogs sngon byon gyi rgya bod rig 'dzin grub thob rnams kyis byin gyis brlabs pa'i gnas su 'byung ba'i mu dra ni gnas skyes kyi mkha' 'gro ste: rigs lnga'i rigs can sha stag yin pas zhing skyes 59)so: sngags skyes ni: o rgyan chen po'i rgyal tshab thabs la brten pa dag gi rigs sras su 'byung ba gnas gsum mkha' 'gro'i rigs sam rab 'bring tha ma gsum gyi mu dra'i mtshan rtags tshang ba ni sngags skyes kyi mkha' 'gro'o: grong skyes ni: 'jig rten gyi yul grong khyim dkar phyogs kyi gnas su 'byung ba'i mu dra ste: don du lhan skyes ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro'i sgyu 'phrul rab 'bring tha ma'i tshul du 'byung ba ni grong skyes ma'o: spyir bud med bdun nam nyer lnga'am brgya rtsa'i nang du ye shes mkha' 'gro yang dag pa gcig yod par nges so: de rnams mi nag glang rgan lta bu gnya' ldeb mkhan dang: so thar gyi lam du zhugs shing gsang sngags la skur 'debs byed pa dbang skal dang mi ldan pa'i gang zag dang 'phrad du mi rung zhing: gal te phrad par gyur na yid bzhin gyi nor bu 'dam khrod du lhung ba dang 'dra ste:

tshe bsod dpal 'byor dbang thang gzi brjid rnams nyams shing phyi ma ngan song du 'gro ba'i rgyu byed par nges so: bu mo 'di dag rnal 'byor pa'i 'dod chags la brten nas rig pa'i btsan sa zin pa dang zung 'jug myur lam bgrod pa'i grogs khyad par can yin: tshe chos 60)longs spyod thams cad gong 'phel du byed pa dang don gnyis 'grub pa'i nor bu rin po che dang 'dra'o: rigs ngan gyi bud med rnams ni yul khams nag phyogs su skye pa dang: mi min gyis gnas su skye 'gro'i srog la rgol ba sha za 'dre mo'i rigs dang lhag len mchod sbyin gyi gral du rgyu ba shugs 'gro ma ste: de dag rnams ni bskyed rdzogs mthar phyin pa'i rnal 'byor pas dbang bskur dam bzhag byas nas mthar ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro'i las byed du gyur nas srid pa las ldog par 'gyur ba yin no: sa ma ya: padma can ni mtshan nyid bcu gsum dang ldan te: mdog dkar la cung zad dmar ba: bzhin mdzes shing dri zhim pa: yan lag phra zhing rked pa ldem pa: skra gnag snum sngo mdangs chags pa: so dkar zhing lce rtse rno ba: sme ba dpral mgrin snyig ga rnams su yod pa: nu ma 'bur zhing bha ga rgyas pa: padma'i bug sgo dog cing bde ba bskyed sla ba rnams phyi lus kyi mtshan nyid do: nang rtsa'i mtshan nyid ni: mthong bas yid chags shing: bltas pas bde ba bskyed pa: rtsa dbu rkyang ro gsum la rtsa mdud nyung ba'i rtags su skad phra la 'khyugs pa: 61)sbyor bas khams dang nyams rtogs yon tan 'phel ba ni nang rtsa'i mtshan nyid do: gsang ba sems kyi mtshan nyid ni: sngags la dad cing sems rgyud drang ba: g.yo sgyu med cing snying rje che ba: gtong phod che zhing mchod sbyin la brtson pa: dam tshig ldan cing bskyed rdzogs kyi gnad la mi rmongs pa: nyon mongs chung zhing mched lcam la brtse gdung che ba: bla ma lha la gus pa: nyams rtogs yon tan dang ldan pa ni gsang ba sems kyi mtshan nyid do:

sa ma ya: dung can ma ni: phyi lus kyi mtshan nyid dkar la snum pa'i mdangs can: nu ma 'bur zhing padma rgyas pa: skra gnag cing g.yas su 'khyil ba: so dkar zhing so phreng mnyam pa: yan lag 'phen sdud sla zhing rked pa ldem pa: sme ba mchan dang dku la yod pa ni lus kyi mtshan nyid do: nang rtsa'i mtshan nyid ni: ro rkyang dbu ma dang rtsa 'khor rnams su khrag dang chu ser nyung ba'i rtags su yan lag phra la bskyod pa sla ba: rgyu ba'i rlung nyam chung zhing 'gro 'dug spyod lam la bde ba ni rtsa yi mtshan nyid do: gsang ba sems kyi mtshan nyid 62)ni: rgyud zhi zhing dul ba: nyon mongs chung zhing sngags la gus pa: dag snang che zhing dam tshig thub pa: snying rje che zhing ngang rgyud 'jam pa: 'grogs na bde zhing phyi thag ring ba ni gsang ba'i mtshan nyid do: ri dwags mig can ni: phyi lus kyi mtshan nyid mdog dkar la smug shas che ba: phung po sgyu rtsal sgod cing bzhin legs pa: nu ma 'bur zhing bha ga rgyas pa: skra nag la so phreng mnyam pa: ri dwags kyi mig dang 'dra ba dkar nag phyed pa: kha chung zhing so ser ba: mche ba zur rno ba: lce srab pas gtam brjod pa la mkhas pa: lus bong che zhing yan lag skyon med pa: rked pa phra zhing bde ba'i sgyu rtsal la mkhas pa rnams ni lus kyi mtshan nyid do: nang rtsa'i mtshan nyid ni: ro rkyang dbu gsum la rtsa mdud nyung ba dang: khrag dang chu ser gyis ma dgos pa'i rtags su dbang po'i sgo la skyon med cing rtsa ring zhing rno bas bde ba mchog tu ster ba rnams ni nang rtsa'i mtshan nyid do: gsang ba sems kyi mtshan nyid ni: dag snang phyogs med du yod pa: bla ma lha dang rdo rje mched lcam la dad cing gus pa: 63)gsang sngags kyi lam la slob sla ba: bskyed rdzogs la yid ches shing byang chub kyi sems dang ldan pa ni sems kyi mtshan nyid do: sa ma ya: glang po can ma ni: phyi lus kyi mtshan nyid lus la gnyer ma med cing bzhin mdzes pa:

mdog sngo la dmar ba'i mdangs chags pa: skrag nag cing snum pa: skad cung zad phra zhing sna rtse rno ba: nu ma gting phra zhing padma'i sgo cung zad dog pa: sme ba mchan g.yas dang lte 'og tu yod pa ni lus kyi mtshan nyid do: nang rtsa'i mtshan nyid ni: rtsa gsum lo 'dab yal ga mang zhing yar sne gsum kha dang sna la zug pas kha chung zhing lce srab la rno zhing mdzes pa'o: gsang ba sems kyi mtshan nyid ni: zhi dul byang sems dang ldan pa: mig ser chung zhing sngags la dad pa: shes rab rno zhing dag snang che ba: log lta chung zhing ngang rgyud 'jam pa: nyams snang gsal zhing phrag dog chung ba ni gsang ba sems kyi mtshan nyid do: sa ma ya: dpal be'u ma ni: phyi lus kyi mtshan nyid lus bong ring zhing cha snyoms pa: rked pa phra zhing mdog dkar 64)ba: yan lag rnams 'phen sdud sla zhing po pho brang mnyam pa: sme ba snying ga dang sog 'dab g.yas na yod pa: gnyer ma nyung zhing yid 'phrog pa: 'grogs na bde ba rnams ni lus kyi mtshan nyid do: nang rtsa'i mtshan nyid ni: dbu rkyang ro gsum mdud pa nyung zhing bde ba'i rtsa rno zhing 'phar ba: rlung gi rgyu ba rags shing sgyu rtsal rgod pa ni nang rtsa'i mtshan nyid do: gsang ba sems kyi mtshan nyid ni: snying rje che zhing dad pa dang dag snang che ba: brtson 'grus ldan cing sngags la mos pa: mched grogs la brtse dung che zhing gus pa: rim gnyis kyi lam nyams su len pa la mos pa ni gsang ba sems kyi mtshan nyid do: sa ma ya: de ltar rigs can gyi mu dra lnga ni gsang sngags bla na med pa'i lam nyams su blang ba'i grogs su bsngags pa yin: de las kyang padma can rab ni reg grol gyi mu dra yid bzhin gyi nor bu dang 'dra ste shin tu dkon pa'i gnas so: spyir phyi lus kyi mtshan nyid mdog dkar la dmar mdangs chags pa: snum la mdzes shing dri zhim pa: rked pa phra zhing sha tshags dam pa: so dkar zhing lce srab pa: skra

65)gnag la cung zad sngo mdangs chags shing snum pa: skad phra zhing 'gyur khug ldeb pa: kha chung zhing mchu cung zad ring ba bimba'i mdog ltar dmar ba: mthong bas yid 'phrog cing 'dod pa 'phral du slong ba: sha 'jam zhing 'khril na bde ba: dpa' bo rab la dbang phyir gnas lnga dang brla g.yas g.yon rnams su sme ba yod pa: sna yi rtse sno zhing kha nas utpa la'i dri ngang ldang ba: mig kyang padma'i spyan dang byang chub sems dpa'i spyan dang ri dwags kyi mig dang ldan pa: yan lag phra la spyod lam mdzes pa'o: nang rtsa yi mtshan nyid kyang rtsa gsum mdud pa nyung zhing khrag dang chu ser gyis ma gos pa'i rtags su bde stong gi ye shes 'bar zhing bltas na tshim pa: reg na bde ba khyad par can ster ba: padma'i bug sgo dog cing phyi dbyibs zlum po dang gru bzhi dang zla gam dang zur gsum mam chos 'byung gi rnam par gnas so: bde ba'i rtsa yang rigs lnga'i rtsa dbyibs so sor ldan cing rtsa rtse phra la nyug nyug tu 'phar nas reg pa'i lam chel ba: 'phrad pa'i tshe rdo rje ngal dub med cing bde ba bskyed pa: de yang bde ba'i rtsa 66)phra zhing ring ba 'og sgor gnas pa: dga' ba'i rtsa la nges shing phra la myur ba: 'phrad pa tsam gyis bde steng gi ye shes mngon du gyur nas zung 'jug gi lam la dka' tshegs med par grol nus pa yin no: gsang ba sems kyi mtshan nyid ni: sgo gsum zhi zhing dul ba: snying rje che zhing yar mchod mar sbyin la dga' ba: gsang sngags la yid ches shing bskyed rdzogs dang ldan pa: bla ma lha la dag snang dang brtse gdung che ba: nyon mongs chung zhing shes rab che ba: rgyud drang zhing mig ser chung ba: byang chub kyi sems dang ldan zhing rim gnyis kyi lam la brtson pa: rtag tu dman sa bzung zhing phrag dog chung ba: rnal 'byor pa la dad cing ci gsung tshad mar 'dzin pa: gtong phod che zhing thabs la mkhas pa: bla ma dang mched grogs la brtse gdung che zhing tshul dang mthun pa:

'grogs na bde ba dang mthun pa yin no: sa ma ya: der phrad pas rnal 'byor pa'i bskyed rdzogs kyi grogs su 'gro: tshe chos bsod nams gdul bya rgyas: nyams rtogs kyi yon tan dang ldan: zung 'jug gi rtogs pa mthar phyin nas 'og min gyis gnas su 67)bgrod pa'i lam grogs khyad par can yin no: de ltar rab 'bring tha ma gsum gang yin kyang grong pa'i chos kyis ma gos pa dang: ma smin pa'i sad kyis ma phog pa dang: sdig can dam nyams dang ma 'dres shing: bcu gnyis bcu drug nyi shu ma ste lha klu mi'i bu mo zhes na tshod de rnams las ma yol ba bsten pa gal che: khyad par du nang rtsa dang gsang ba sems kyi mtshan nyid gal che ba yin no: de ltar mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i phyag rgya de nyid thabs khyad par can gyis bkug nas dang po dbang gis rgyud smin par byin gyis brlabs: de nas grol byed kyi khrid bstsal nas smon 'jug don dam byang chub kyi sems bsgom pa dang: gsang sngags bla med kyi bskyed rdzogs la bslab cing rim gnyis la drod rtags thon par bya: so byang sngags gsum gyi dam tshig rnams mig 'bras bzhin bsrung ba dang: lam lnga sa bcu rim bgrod kyi tshul du gsang sngags kyi lam la zhugs par bya ba ni gnad dam pa yin par shes par bya'o: sa ma ya: gzhan yang rkang 'jib ma: rus 'cha' ma: dbugs len ma: mdangs 'phrog ma sogs ni dam sri mi'i gzugs su brdzus nas gsang sngags kyi lam la 68)bar chad rtsom zhing dngos grub 'phrog par byed pa'i chom rkun ma zhes grags so: de rnams ni yul nag phyogs rnams su rigs rus ngan pa'i lus su skye ba yin: de yang phyi lus kyi mtshan nyid lus bong che ba mdog sngo la nag pa: skra nag cing ser la rtsub pa: mig chung zhing mkhur tshos mtho ba: sna mtho zhing gdong pa nyag pa: yan lag rnams cha mi snyoms shing sha tshags lhod pa: gnyer ma mang zhing skra dang ba spu ring ba:

nu ma rgyas shing che ba: gsang spu mang ba: ham pa dang rul ba'i dri bro ba: yid du mi 'ong zhing 'grogs na blo sun pa rnams ni phyi'i mtshan nyid do: nang rtsa'i mtshan nyid ni: rtsa dbu skyang ro gsum la mdud pa mang zhing shes rab kyi rtsa mgo thur du bstan cing khrag dang chu ser gyis gos pa: rtsa gzhan rnams kyang ya yo 'khyag 'khyog che ba rnams ni nang rtsa'i mtshan nyid do: gsang ba sems kyi mtshan nyid ni: dad pa dang dag snang chung zhing blo mang ba: ngang rgyud rtsub cing gtong phod chung ba: sems rgya chung zhing nyon mongs che bas phan tshun la mig ser dang tshig rtsub smra ba: chos brgyad la 69)blo phug gtad cing chos la rtsol ba zhan pa sogs ni sems kyi mtshan nyid do: sa ma ya: mtshan ngan gyi mu dra 'di rnams ni bsten du mi rung zhing mchog thun gyi dngos grub dang tshe chos nor gsum ye shes yon tan bsod nams gdul bya thams cad la reg phung gi dug dang 'dra ba yin: yugs sa dam nyams rigs rgyud gcig pa dang: so thar la zhugs pa: sdig can sogs skyes pa gzhan gyis btsogs shing sad phog pa rnams bsten na sgrub pa po sangs rgyas kyi sar bzhugs pa gcig yin kyang gdul bya phrin las gtan nas 'byung mi srid do: sngags la ma brten kyang bla mas gnang ba'i yum skal ni: ma dang bu mo sring mo dang dbang gral gcig tu 'tshogs pa'i grogs rnams 'dod pas tshims par byas na sa bcu rim gyis bgrod nas mchog gi dngos grub rnam mkhyen sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang tshe 'dir thob par 'gyur ro: sa ma ya: de ltar rnal 'byor rab 'bring tha gsum gyi tshul du rig ma'ang de bzh-in du dbang bar 'gyur ba yin: ma rig ma rtogs shing 'dod pa'i dbang gis sdom dang bslab pa dam tshig gi 70)gnas rnams las 'da' ba'i las ni nam yang mi bgyid do: phyi nang gi stong ra dang rlung bcu la dbang 'byor na sngags kyi dgongs don mthar phyin nas tshe 'dir zung 'jug rdo rje 'chang gi go 'phang thob pa'i phyir bde stong zung 'jug gi gdams pa'i smin grol gyi lam la bslab par bya ba ni gnad yin no:

lo zlar rim gnyis kyi lam la brtson pa bas kyang rnal 'byor pa'i nyams rtogs dang ye shes yon tan gdul bya snyan grags thams cad gong 'phel du 'byung ba ni sngags kyi khyad chos so: sa ma ya: de nas sngags kyi 'od gsal mngon du byed pa'i thabs la: gtum mo phyag rgyar sbyor bas kun rtog brgyad cu'i rtog pa bcom: bde stong dga' ba bzhi dang stong bzhi'i 'od gsal mngon du gyur: yid las 'das pa'i ye shes mngon sum sar mthong bar 'gyur ba yin: de yang rtsa ba phyag rgya ma mtshan nyid dang ldan pa la rag las pas: dang po byin gyis brlabs pa'i thabs ni: sin rgyu ra dang li khri byang sems rnams bsres te me long la ha ri ni sa bzhi dga' 'khyil gyi dbus su bkod la: mi mo de nyid bskyed bstim byas nas skad cig gis rdo rje rnal 'byor ma dmar mor 71)gsal ba'i gnas lnga'i rtsa 'khor dbu rkyang gnas thams cad dpa' bo mkha' 'gro 'bum gyi bkod pa yongs su rdzogs par gsal btab: gsang ba padma 'dab bzhir bsgom pa la ha ri ni sa dang dbus su bam̐ yig bkrag 'bar bar bsgom pa las 'od zer 'phros: dpa' bo rnams kyi thugs rgyud bskul: mkha' spyod kyi mkha' 'gro ma rnams spyan drangs nas phyag rgya dang gnyis su med par thim: ḍā ki ni hring hring st+wam: zhes mang du bzlas te me long ngos kyi rdzas rnams mi mo'i gnas lngar byugs pas byin gyis brlabs par 'gyur ro: de nas tshogs kyi 'khor lor bskor nas dga' ston la rol: chos skyong la gnyer bcol sogs bya'o: sa ma ya: sgyu lus stong ra la bslab pa ni: bdag nyid rdo rje rnal 'byor ma dmar mo gsal ba'i spyi bo bde chen gyi 'khor lor haṃ yig dkar po bkrag 'bar bar gsal ba dang: lte ba'i 'khor lor a shad dmar po mtshan nyid bzhi ldan bsgom: ro rkyang gnyis nas rags pa'i rlung rngubs te phra ba'i rlung la bsgyur: phra rags gnyis su med par rtsol ba'i rlung la drangs

72)nas skad cig gis rang nyid gnas su gyur pa las dpa' bo he ru kar gsal ba'i 'khor lo lngar rigs lnga yab yum dang: gzhan rtsa gnas thams cad du dpa' bo dang dpa' mo'i grong khyer til gong kha phye ba ltar bsgom: sngar bzhin du spyi bo bde chen gyi 'khor lor haṃ yig dkar po dang: sprul pa'i 'khor lor a shad dmar po bsgom zhing gsang ba'i rdo rje rdo rje rtse lnga pa hūm̐ yig dkar po mgo thur bstan du gsal gdab: shes rab phyag rgya ma yang rdo rje rnal 'byor mar gsal ba'i rtsa khams thams cad dang: khyad par du rtsa gsum 'khor lo lngar dpa' bo yab yum lnga dang ḍā ki dpa' bo'i tshogs thams cad kyang til gong rgyas pa ltar gsal gdab: spyi bo dang lte ba'i 'khor lo'i dbus su thabs shes kyi sa bon dang rgyu'i thig le yang gsal: gsang ba'i bha ga padma 'dab bzhi'i dbus su āḥlam̐ dang bam̐ yig gis mtshan pa can du gsal gdab: phyi 'byung chen gyi rlung kha dog lnga ldan ye shes lnga'i ngo bor dbyings nas drangs te ro rkyang nas zhugs te dbu mar bsdu: snang cha thabs dang stong cha shes rab tu gsal gdab ste rdo rje dang padma kha sbyor nas steng 'og gi rlung kha sbyor du bzung: sems nyid ngal 73)gso zhing bar rlung bum pa can du bskyil: de ltar yang yang bzung ba'i rjes su lte ba'i a shad las me 'bar dbu ma'i nang gyen du mched de spyi bo'i haṃ dang yab yum reg pa 'phrod pa'i bde bas bskul te: haṃ yig las bdud rtsi dkar po bde ba'i rang bzhin babs te rtsa 'khor rnams rim par gang bar bsam la rdo rje dal bus bskyod cing 'khor lo dang po nas dga' ba'i ye shes: gnyis pa nas mchog dga'i ye shes: gsum pa nas khyad par du dga' ba'i ye shes: bzhi pa nas lhan skyes dga' ba'i ye shes ngos zin par bya: gsang gnas bde ba skyong ba'i 'khor lor babs pa'i tshe na nyon mongs pa'i sgrib pa mtha' dag bcom nas rgyu'i sa bcu mthar phyin par 'gyur ba yin:

de nas thig le rdo rje'i bum par babs pa'i tshe na: dga' ba'i ye shes dang stong pa'i 'od gsal mngon du gyur: rdo rje'i rtse mor byon pa na mchog dga'i ye shes dang stong pa chen po'i 'od gsal mngon du gyur: dkar dmar zhal mjal ba'i tshe na khyad par du dga' ba'i ye shes dang thams cad stong pa'i 'od gsal mngon du gyur: dwangs ma phyir log 74)cing dkar dmar mnyam sbyor gyi bdud rtsis skye mched kyi lha rnams tshims parabyas pas bsod nams kyi tshogs rdzogs: snang gsum 'dres pa'i bag chags gzhi la bcom: don dam 'od gsal ba'i ye shes kyi gnas lugs mthar thug pa'i lhan skyes kyi dga' ba dang shin tu stong pa'i 'od gsal mngon du gyur pas ye shes kyi tshogs rdzogs: de ltar 'bras bu sa gsum rdzogs pa na dmigs med zang thal rjen pa'i gshigs lugs su mnyam par 'jog go: slar yang rig stong 'od gsal gyi ngang de las mi g.yo bzhin du: thugs rje'i cho 'phrul rjes chags su shar bas bsrubs sbyor gyi las la spyod nas thig le yas brtan thabs dang: mas brtan shes rab kyi dga' ba bcu drug la dran pa nye bar 'jog cing dgram 'dren dbab skyil gyi gnad kyis mthong bas: snang ba bde stong ye shes: gsal ba 'gyu stong ye shes: sems rtog dran stong ye shes: gnyug ma rig stong ye shes: snang phyogs stong pa'i 'od gsal: 'gyu 'phrig stong pa chen po: dran bsam thams cad stong pa: rig pa shin tu stong pa chen po ste: de ltar 'od gsal de dag gis nye bar drangs pa'i ye shes lam du byed pas rtsa thig rlung gsum 75)gyi dri ma mtha' dag sbyangs nas: lus dag rtsa sku: ngag dang rlung gsung: yid dang thig le thugs: nyon mongs ye shes: shes sgrib shes rab chen por 'phos nas don dam brjod med kyi 'od gsal mngon du gyur nas rgyu lus zung 'jug dag pa rdo rje'i sku gsung thugs kyi rang bzhin du 'gyur ro:

kun rtog gi bag chags ma dag pa'i sgo gsum du snang ba'i chos thams cad bde stong gnyis su med pa'i ye shes chen po'i lam gyi sbyangs pa mthar son pas: dbang bzhi gcig car du thob nas sku gsum gyi 'bras bu mngon du gyur te srid gsum ngang rdzogs kyi sa la phyin par 'gyur ro: thog babs kyi ting nge 'dzin gyis rgyas thebs pas gnyis 'dzin bag chags kun rtog gis 'khrul snang thams cad dbyings su ldog ste ma dag pa'i rtsa mdud thams cad grol nas ye shes zang thal ba'i rang zhal mjal: shes rab kyi rtsal 'bar nas chos thams cad kyi gnas lugs la phyin ci ma log pa'i mkhyen pa thob: rig pa skye 'gag gnas gsum dang bral ba'i ye shes mngon du gyur pa'o: yab yum gyis sbyor mtshams nas dkar dmar gyi 'od zer ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rnam par 76)'phros pas phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba sras bcas dang brgyud gsum rig 'dzin gyi tshogs dang bcas pa rnams la mnyes pa'i mchod pa phul: zag med bde stong gi bdud rtsi'i ros tshims: bdag gzhan sems can thams cad kyi sgrib pa sbyangs: tshogs rdzogs: lha tshogs rnams kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i nus mthu thams cad 'od zer gyi sna la drangs nas bdag yab yum gyi sbyor mtshams la thim pas lus dkyil gyi lha tshogs rnams dgyes shing tshims pas ye shes kyi rtogs pa mngon du gyur: lus kyi mdangs rgyas gnyer ma med cing gzhon sha chags: 'khor lo rnams kyi rtsa mdud grol ba'i rtags su shes pa nyams spro zhing rig pa hur phyungs te snang srid brda chos su shar ba sogs yon tan mtha' dag yar ldan du nges so: 'di ni 'bras bu ye shes kyi tshogs chen rdzogs pa'i thabs khyad par can bla med gsang ba'i mchod pa yin pas tshogs bsags gzhan gyi do zla med pa'o: de lta bu'i tshe 'di nyid la zung 'jug gi sku gal te ma 'grub kyang chags pa chen pos nyon mongs sa lam du byas pas 'od gsal la sems bzung ba tsam gyis nyon sgrib dag cing rtsa thig rlung gi sgrib pa

77)sbyangs nas mthar skye ba gcig gam gsum las mi 'gyang bar gsang sngags kyi grub 'bras mngon du gyur pa'o: gzhan yang brgyud 'dzin gyi sprul pa'i sku yod par 'dod na yab yum lhar gsal ba'i rdor pad hrīḥ.āḥsgom pa'i sbyor mtshams nas 'od zer lcags kyu'i dbyibs ltar 'phros pas gang 'dod pa'i sprul pa'i sku'i thugs de bsdus nas byang sems la bstim: yab yum gyi lhums su zhugs par dmigs shing yang yang gsal gdab rgyas 'debs kyi gnad dang ldan tshe sprul pa'i sku 'byung bar 'gyur ro: de nas zhi rgyas dbang drag gi dmigs pa'i lde kha ni: yab yum lhar gsal ba'i sbyor mtshams nas 'od zer dkar po 'phros: rdo rje rigs kyi dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams la mchod pa phul: thugs kyi dgyes pa bskangs nas sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las thams cad 'od dkar gyi rnam par byung nas sbyor mtshams su thim pas nad gdon 'jigs brgyad 'gal rkyen bar chad thams cad zhi nas me long ye shes mngon du gyur par bsam: yang sbyor mtshams nas 'od zer ser gsal 'phros nas rin chen rigs kyi dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams la mchod 78)pa 'bul: thugs kyi dgyes pa bskangs: de dag rnams kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las thams cad 'od zer ser po'i rnam par bsdus nas sbyor mtshams su thim pas tshe bsod dpal 'byor thams cad rgyas shing mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes mngon du gyur par bsam: yang sbyor mtshams nas 'od zer dmar po 'phros nas padma rigs kyi lha tshogs rnams kyi sku gsung thugs la mnyes pa'i mchod pa phul: thugs kyi dgyes pa bskangs: de dag rnams kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las 'od dmar gyi rnam par byung nas sbyor mtshams su thim pas khams gsum dbang du sdud cing srid gsum zil gyis gnon pa'i mthu thob: dbang gi las gang brtsams thams cad thogs med du 'grub cing so sor rtogs pa'i ye shes mngon du gyur par bsam:

yang 'od zer ljang gsal 'phros pas karma rigs kyi lha tshogs rnams kyi sku gsung thugs la mnyes pa'i mchod pa phul bas thugs kyi dgyes pa bskangs: de dag rnams kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las thams cad 'od dmar gyi rnam par byung nas sbyor mtshams su thim pas mkha' gsang raṃ yig gis mtshan pa las 'od zer me dpung dang khro tshogs kyi rnam par 79)'phros pas dri za nyer len gyi rnam par shes pa'i rgyu lam bcad pa dang: gdug pa can thams cad bsregs bcad btub cing de dag gi tshe bsod rang la bstims shing rnam par shes pa bdag gzhan dbyer med bde ba chen po'i ngang du grol nas bya ba grub pa'i ye shes mngon du gyur par bsam mo: yang yab yum lhar gsal ba'i sbyor mtshams nas 'od zer mthing nag 'phros nas sangs rgyas rigs kyi dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams la mchod pa phul bas thugs kyi dgyes pa bskangs: de dag rnams kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las thams cad 'od zer mthing ga'i rnam par byung nas yab yum gyi sbyor mtshams su thim pas ye gnas lhun grub kyi ye shes gnyis su med par mthong nas chos dbyings ye shes mngon du gyur par bsam mo: de dag ni zung 'jug mthar phyin pa'i rnal 'byor rab kyi spyod lam gyi chos so: thabs la brten pas sgyu lus 'od skur grol nas tshe 'di nyid la yab yum gnyis 'khor ba'i chos kyis ma gos shing nyon mongs rang sar grol nas dag smin rdzogs gsum mthar phyin te thun mong gi grub pa brgyad la mnga' brnyes shing: mchog gi rig 'dzin bzhi'i sa thob nas don gnyis 80)kyi mdzad pa yid bzhin du 'grub par nges so: de min gang zag blo dman 'og ma rnams la ni skal ba med pas bdud rtsi dug tu 'gyur nas ngan song gi gting rdo byed par 'gyur ba yin: sngags la kha g.yar nas nyon mongs 'chol nyog tu spyod pa de dag la ni rlung phyogs tsam yang 'chad du mi rung zhing ru tra'i sgor ltung nas dmyal ba'i bud shing byed par 'gyur ro:

'di ni mkha' 'gro'i snying bcud zab mo'i chos yin pas gcig brgyud gyis la gsang bar spel cig: sa ma ya: gsang zhing gsang bar spel las dngos grub thob: yongs la 'chad na mkha' 'gro'i bka' chad 'bebs: gsang sngags skyon du yod pa ma yin te: blo dman rnams kyis bdud rtsi dug tu mthong: de phyir shin tu gsang bar nyams su longs: zung 'jug rdo rje 'chang gi sa thob nges: sa ma ya: sku'i rgya: gsung gi rgya: thugs kyi rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: gtad rgya: ḍākki'i rgya: gu hya: brda thim: : e ma myur la zab mo a nu yo ga yi: thabs bsten shes rab mngon gyur gdams pa 'di: pad 'byung bdag gis mtsho rgyal 81)khyod la gtad: phyi rabs don du rin chen gter du sbos: ma 'ongs snyigs ma nyi shu kha ral dus: gsang sngags drod rtags chung zhing byin rlabs nyams: theg dman sngags la kha g.yar khyim thabs 'dzin: sngags pas dam tshig nyams nas mgo reg byed: dge slong 'dul khrims nyams nas nag chang spyod: rnal 'byor rnams la brnyas byed rku 'phrog bcom: dmag 'khrug la sogs mi 'dod sna tshogs 'byung: de dus chos 'di spyod pa'i skal ldan ni: khyod kyi gsung sprul chu khams 'brug lo pa: sbas pa'i tshul 'chang su kha badzra rtsal: nges med gnas su 'gro rnams rjes su 'dzin: nga sprul thabs kyi mchog gyur rig pa 'dzin: gsang grogs dpa' bo gsang sngags ming mtha' can: 'dir phrad brda 'grol 'gro don dus babs 'gyur: las can thabs grogs ya gsum chos bdag bcu: bu slob dang bcas chos 'dis grol bar nges: bka' srung ma mo gza' dang rdo rje legs: gnod sbyin shan pa'i tshogs kyis thub par srungs: skal ldan las 'phro can dang 'phrad par shog: skal med log lta can la 'di ma 'phrad: dam nyams lag tu ma shor dam du zungs: yongs la ma spel gnyer gyis sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: brda thim:

ces pa'ang dus ring mo nas gsang grogs tiṣṭha badzra dang bī ma la rasmi gnyis kyis bka' gnang spyi bor phebs pa dang lung zin chos kyi bdag po padma snyan grags kyis gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i dam tshig gi rdzas khyad par du 'phags pa thabs shes rdo rje dril bu dang dza gad kyi btung ba'i skyes dang bcas te bskul ba'i tshe na brda don gsal yang brda 'khrugs che ba dang*/ khams 'dus kyi rkyen du ma la brten nas btang snyoms su bzhag yod skabs/ nye char skyes phreng du mar gsang gter rgya mtsho'i lde mig thabs grogs mchog tu gyur pa mtshan brjod par dka' yang*/ don gyi slad du mtshan nas brjod na o rgyan dngos snang padma 'gro 'dul gsang sngags gling pas rten 'brel phun sum tshogs pa nyid kyi gter byon kun mkhyen rin po che'i 'dra sku tshad ldan dang*/ ga ṇa tsakra'i mchod pa yid 'ong bcas spyi bor son tshe/ gtad rgya btsan thabs su sad pa'i mthu la brten nas bdag bde chen bde ba'i rdo rjes rang lo sum cu pa bskal pa lcags bya lo'i dmar phyogs kyi dus dge bar: rdo yul smad kyi cha surya'i ming gi lung pa 83) bkra shis chos khri'i la kha gsang sngags bde chen gling gi sgrub gnas dam pa gnas khang 'od gsal 'khyil ba nas mkha' 'gro'i snyan brgyud zab mo gtan la phab pa'o// dge'o// 84)
